note: Election results for the Devon map. Ward party = the party holding most of the ward's seats as elected at the last full election (Exeter: the 2023, 2024 and 2026 winners); later by-elections and defections are not shown in the ward colours. Council control is current as of the date given.
sources: District results 2019 and 2023, Exeter 2023, 2024 and 2026: Wikipedia election pages, which reproduce each council's declarations of result.
2024 general election: Exeter Observer's Devon results page (returning officers' declarations).

Notional 2019 general election on 2024 boundaries (Rallings & Thrasher, for the BBC/ITV/Sky/PA): Wikipedia constituency pages and PollCheck. North Devon's boundary did not change, so its notional result is the actual 2019 result.
Council control and seats: Wikipedia council pages and PollCheck, as of the date shown for each council.
